MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 23
   D. 17

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

5. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 19
   D. 12

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 10

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

16. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Working:

2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
